headline: Bulgaria remains among the countries with the highest inflation in the eurozone
summary: Eurostat's preliminary estimate shows eurozone inflation accelerating, mainly due to energy. Bulgaria remains among the countries with the highest inflation rates.
why: Eurostat is the EU statistics office, and its flash inflation estimates guide European Central Bank policy expectations.
